label: FACIS DSP — Catalogue
info:
FR-DSP-001 — POST /dsp/catalogue/request.

The catalogue is DERIVED from the FACIS Data Sink's queryable store: the
derivation node lists live gold-layer tables in the Trino/Iceberg lakehouse
and merges them with /data/dsp-config/datasets.json, which acts as a rich
metadata OVERLAY and as an offline FALLBACK. See
docs/architecture/fap-role-mapping.md for the FACIS Data Sink role.

Merge semantics (dsp-cat-derive-fn):
  - overlay entry whose gold table is live   -> kept as-is (rich metadata wins)
  - overlay entry whose table is NOT live    -> dropped (warn)
  - live gold table with no overlay entry    -> minimal auto-derived entry
  - catalogueSource = 'lakehouse' on success

Availability over strictness: on ANY Trino failure the derivation never
empties an already-populated catalogue; if the catalogue is still empty it
falls back to the full overlay file (catalogueSource = 'overlay-fallback').
The startup file-read (dsp-cat-read) seeds the catalogue within ms at boot;
the derivation replaces it once Trino answers and re-runs every 10 minutes.

Filter + cursor logic mirrors src/dsp-connector/catalogue_store.py:7-139:
  - filter.assetType        -> exact match on metadata.assetType
  - filter.datasetIds        -> set membership on dataset.id
  - page.limit (default 50)  -> slice size
  - page.cursor              -> integer offset; non-numeric -> 0
  - nextCursor               -> str(start+limit) when more remain, else null
